title: Yeast Transformation Protocol
author: Marijn Ceelen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7jkhkkw
materials: Make a transformation mix consisting of:

steps.title: Prepare Yeast Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1.5 mL tubes containing 100 µL of yeast competent cells for 2 minutes at 5000x g and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Add Transformation Mix
steps.instruction: Add 360 µL of the transformation mix to the 1.5 mL tubes containing the cells and vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Heat-Shock Cells
steps.instruction: Heat-shock the solution at 42 ºC for 40 minutes.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells for 2 minutes at 5000x g and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend and Divide Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of YPD medium and divide the volume into two separate 1.5 mL tubes.

steps.title: Recover Cells
steps.instruction: Allow cells to recover for 1.5 hours at 30 ºC and 300 rpm.

steps.title: Concentrate Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cells for 2 minutes at 5000x g and decant the supernatant, leaving a small amount of medium inside the tubes.

steps.title: Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in the remaining medium and plate 50 µL onto an SC plate lacking the amino acid used as a selection marker.

steps.title: Incubate Plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells for 3 days at 30 ºC.
